title: Your Son

text.lead: Your Son (Spanish: Tu hijo) is a 2018 thriller drama film directed by Miguel Ángel Vivas and written by Vivas and Alberto Marini. It stars José Coronado, Ana Wagener, Asia Ortega, Pol Monen and Ester Expósito.
text.plot: The plot revolves around Jaime Jiménez, a surgeon who starts to investigate the beating of his teenage son, Marcos, outside a nightclub.
text.cast:
- José Coronado as Jaime Jiménez
- Ana Wagener as Carmen
- Asia Ortega as Sara
- Pol Monen as Marcos
- Ester Expósito as Andrea
- Marco H. Medina as Pedro
- Gonzalo Hermoso as Albino
- Sergio Castellanos as Raúl
- Luis Bermejo as Manolo
- Ramiro Alonso as Juan
- Paqui Montoya as María José
- Vicente Romero as Alberto
- José Blanco as Salva
- Marta Romero as María
- Sauce Ena as Inspector Moreno
text.release: Your Son premiered as the opening film of the 63rd Valladolid International Film Festival (Seminci) on 20 October 2018. It was released theatrically in Spain on 9 November 2018 by eOne. It was released internationally on Netflix on 1 March 2019.
